title: 3-Port TJ Box – Efficient Fiber & Cable Junction Solution

items.h: High-quality product suitable for professional FTTH and networking projects
Ideal choice for ISPs, technicians, and home networking setups
Durable enclosure ensures safer long-term cable protection

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The 3-Port TJ Box is a compact and durable fiber optic junction box designed for FTTH, FTTX, and home networking applications. It provides a secure and organized solution for managing fiber splicing, cable routing, and termination points. With its 3-port output design, this TJ box is ideal for small network setups, home internet connections, and mini optical distribution points.


Key Features


  • 3-Port Design – Supports up to three fiber cables, perfect for small FTTH or indoor network installations.
  • Durable Build Quality – Made from high-grade ABS plastic for strength, longevity, and heat resistance.
  • Easy Wall-Mount Installation – Compact size fits neatly on walls for clean, professional cable management.
  • Secure Cable Protection – Shields fiber connections from dust, moisture, and physical damage.
  • Ideal for FTTH/FTTX Projects – Suitable for ISP setups, home ONU/ONT connections, and mini fiber distribution points.
  • Neat Cable Organization – Keeps patch cords, pigtails, and splicing points well-organized.
